_comment: Copy to pipeline/05-prompt/<project>/insert.json. Its presence switches the pipeline to the complex (app-insert) flow. Absent = plain text-to-video and nothing else runs.
_plate_window_note: Advisory only. The real insert range is taken from where the green screen actually exists, because the model does not cut exactly on the prompted times.
_key_note: Chroma tolerances. Widen hue_tol if screen edges fail to key; raise sat_min if parts of the room key by mistake.
_prereq_note: This only works if the plate cooperates. The phone must be held completely still (no drift, rotation, tilt or re-grip) or the tracked quad moves and the app slides against the bezel; and every thumb gesture in the plate must correspond to a real event in the source recording, in the same order and on the right part of the screen. Both are prompt problems, fixed in stage 5, not here. `ugckit qc` reports phone drift as a percentage of screen width -- under 8% is locked, over 20% will not composite cleanly.
_beats_note: app_t = where the event sits in the source recording. plate_t = where the PROMPT asked the thumb to act. AFTER GENERATING, re-measure the thumb on the real plate and correct every plate_t. The compositor piecewise time-warps the source so each beat lands on the actual thumb frame — this is what makes the timing exact despite model drift, and skipping it is what makes an insert look pasted on.
_patches_note: Cover regions of the source that should not appear. Copies the region from from_t over the given window. Coordinates are in the SOURCE recording's own pixel space.
_grade_note: Sit the insert into the plate. A perfectly clean screen inside a phone-camera plate reads as fake.
_smooth_note: Savitzky-Golay window on the tracked quad. KEEP THIS SMALL. The generated phone morphs frame to frame and the app must deform with the bezel; over-smoothing makes the screen slide against the phone.
